notes.title: Info of 0.1.1 Early Access
notes.content:
so since i released the early access for this game and this update is gonna be quite big i'll tell you guys a few things:

- Part 2 (floor 1) will be available
- CO-OP will be available
- bug fixes or issues will be adressed
- Entities will be available (cause umm it's getting kinda lonely)



i'd like to mention that it is my problem for not releasing a rather decent looking game but it's at the cost of being an early access game and will not reflect the final product.

Co-op is a way to put your friends into the facility to grab clues, avoid guards, entities and advance further into the game's massive facility.

Most of the game's playtime revolves around the facility but that doesnt mean in the future there wont be any new levels.


as the game evolves into a greater and playable state i have to say any feedback is appreciated as long as it's reasonable and constructive.

notes.title: Early Access Announcement!
notes.content:
So to everyone's surprise (or not idk)

I have decided to announce that the Early access version will drop within this week (or next week depending on the amount of issues the game has before releasing it)

the first early access version will only include the first part of the game and eventually lead to the second part which is a big facility and in there you gotta avoid enemies while finding ways to escape.

the first part of the game at this point consists of 7 main levels including the first 2 prologue levels.

also in the near future i'll develop some sort of a multiplayer map for everyone to enjoy now that i have the needed resources to do so.

but for now you guys will only have 7 levels (+2 prologue levels which in total is 9 so uhh yee have fun)



[b]Why early access you ask?[/b]


obviously the reason for me to put it early access is to let YOU guys have a little look at the game and provide feedback so that in the full release the game is in a stable and polished state.

this will help me tremendously since im one guy and i dont have a QA tester team like some sort of small studio.

im a one man team creating these games for you guys to enjoy!

anyways see you in a few days (hopefully)

notes.title: Release date news #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Since the game is still in development and I want to give a little more specific releases im just straight up saying late 2023

Secret backrooms 2 alongside the old backrooms coming back before the sequel releases!

Now to get some clarifications away the first one will be an update that gets the game an entire overhaul from UI to movement and levels.

The beginning levels are quite different from the main one much like the sequel which the two games will intertwine together. Im aiming a release for the old game to get a mid summer to September release!. There won’t be any multiplayer on both games until I get some server stuff added but until then you guys stick to the single player. Proximity chat is possible if multiplayer is a thing in this game. It’s been a year and I could’ve just released an anniversary update since it’s been 1 year for secret backrooms. I guess the overhaul update will do.

Anyways im looking forward to see how the 6th level will evolve into OH and there will be a Level 6 Gameplay video so you know shits going down

notes.title: Current progress
notes.content:
As of now the game is in a state where i could drop a first part early access, meaning the first half of the game available for everyone to play. A few adjustments and a few levels to make (currently its on level 5 out of the 8 or 9 levels for the first half of the game) I’ll do my best to make it unique with the puzzles even if it’s just a simple code puzzle. I will also let everyone tell me their opinions on the first half when it drops! As of now the game should be released when needed. As im constantly improving my gameplay skills and AI. Already the AI is perfect for the game. I can change the speed, hearing range and sight range. All those depend on each entity and maybe some could be a little persistent.

Overall the game is in a state of slow development progress due to irl stuff but even then i do look forward to everyone having a sneak peek at what’s to come in the next couple of months. There won’t be a second half since it’s literally the entire game.

See you guys soon!
